title: Investidor
description:
Nova oportunidade para Investidor em manaus. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

PROPOSTA EXECUTIVA: YUMMI Status do Projeto: 100% Concluído e Pronto para Rodar O Cenário Atual Muitas startups buscam investimento para tentar construir uma ideia. Nós fizemos o oposto. A Yummi já superou a fase mais arriscada de um negócio de tecnologia. O software está totalmente desenvolvido, testado e validado. Buscamos um parceiro estratégico e financeiro focado exclusivamente em colocar o produto no mercado e acelerar a atração de clientes. O Problema do Mercado Atualmente, os donos de estabelecimentos vivem um caos operacional. Eles sofrem com a fragmentação, precisando contratar, pagar e gerenciar de três a cinco sistemas diferentes para rodar o negócio, como frente de caixa, delivery, financeiro e cardápio digital. Para piorar, as ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial genéricas do mercado falham, erram pedidos em horários de pico e causam prejuízo. A Solução Yummi A Yummi elimina essa bagunça unificando todas as funções essenciais em uma única plataforma centralizada, intuitiva e robusta. Nós corrigimos as falhas das tecnologias comuns, aplicando uma Inteligência Artificial lapidada e integrada de forma nativa. O comerciante elimina custos com múltiplos softwares, reduz despesas fixas e gerencia o negócio inteiro com um único login. Risco Zero de Desenvolvimento O maior medo de um investidor em tecnologia é o atraso ou o fracasso no desenvolvimento do software. Na Yummi, esse risco não existe. O produto mínimo viável está cem por cento concluído e funcional. A infraestrutura está pronta e testada para suportar alta demanda de acessos. Nosso foco atual é zero por cento em programação e cem por cento em marketing e vendas. Destinação do Capital e Custos Base Todo o capital aportado será direcionado estrategicamente para gerar tração imediata e receita. Oitenta por cento (80%) do recurso será aplicado diretamente em Marketing e Aquisição de Novos Clientes, utilizando estratégias agressivas de tráfego pago no Google e Meta Ads, ações locais e canais comerciais para acelerar a entrada de novos usuários na plataforma. Os vinte por cento (20%) restantes serão mantidos como Contingência e Operação, garantindo a estabilidade absoluta de servidores como AWS ou Firebase e o suporte técnico inicial para que os novos clientes tenham uma experiência impecável. Por que a Yummi é um Investimento Confiável? Como a Yummi centraliza toda a operação do cliente, o custo de mudança para ele é muito alto, o que garante uma taxa de cancelamento extremamente baixa e retenção prolongada. Além disso, o modelo é altamente escalável: os custos de servidor são previsíveis e, conforme a base de clientes cresce, a margem de lucro líquido aumenta exponencialmente. Oferecemos total transparência, com relatórios mensais detalhados de crescimento, usuários ativos e faturamento. O motor já está construído e ligado. Só precisamos do combustível para o marketing.

Maintain internal financial controls and accounting procedures. Prepare and analyze the company’s accountant closing to ensure accuracy and transparency. Develop accounting reports to support decision-making.The ideal profileWe're on the lookout for someone who not only shares our values and ambitions but also envisions growing alongside Move Up Media. As a dedicated team player, you embody fair play, transparency, agility, and an unstoppable drive. You're the perfect fit for our team if you:Have outstanding written and verbal communication skills in Portuguese and English. Understand Brazilian tax regulations, including the new tax reform (IBS, CBS), and international accounting standards (IFRS). Demonstrate strong knowledge of accounting principles, daily journal entries, and monthly, quarterly, and annual closings. Have a minimum of 3–5 years of experience as Analista Contábil. Hold a Bachelor’s degree in Accounting. Are proficient in accounting software — knowledge of Odoo is a plus. Excel in advanced Excel skills and familiarity with financial analysis tools. Be ambitious, adaptable, and thrive in fast-paced environments. Focus on accuracy, compliance, and delivering reliable financial information. Show active listening, resilience, and persistence. Demonstrate strong problem-solving abilities and effective task coordination. Excel in time management, organization, and planning. Manage multiple accounts and tasks simultaneously. Use analytical skills and a data-driven mindset for decision-making. Thrive in teamwork and adapt well to evolving environments.Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! Second Interview:A chat with HR to understand you better and ensure a cultural fit with Move Up Media. Third Interview:A conversation with our CFO to align on technical expectations and ensure you're the right fit for our finance team. Final Step:A proposition for us to start working together!What’s in it for youRemote Work Environment:Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely full-time. Flexible Schedule:We measure results, not hours, and offer paid time off. Development Opportunities:As a rapidly growing startup, we offer numerous possibilities for career advancement and support your career path. Team Gatherings:Annual team get-togethers to connect, work, and have fun. We strive to find enjoyable spots for everyone. Wellness Fund:€1,000 per year dedicated to your professional development, sports, or cultural events of your choice.Move Up MediaWe're a dynamic and driven team that's all about growth. Partnering with top-notch brands in the exciting worlds of i Gaming and sports, we're on a mission to connect sports fans to global advertisers. SEO is our bread and butter, and we're relentless in our pursuit of getting our websites to the top of search results for all the best—and sometimes toughest—keywords. With bases in both France and Brazil, we're making waves across 20+ markets. And here's the best part: we're a 100% remote team that thrives on efficiency and flexibility. So if you're ready to join a company that's all about results and values your work-life balance, we'd love to hear from you!Here at Move Up Media, we believe in the power of diversity and inclusion. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all individuals, regardless of their background, race, gender, sexual orientation, or abilities. We celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each person brings to the table, and we strive to create a welcoming and supportive environment where everyone can thrive and succeed. We firmly believe that a diverse workforce leads to greater teamwork and success. Join us in our journey towards a more inclusive and equitable future! title: Reiseberater:in brasilien (freelance, vor ort)
description:
Confira a vaga para Reiseberater:in brasilien (freelance, vor ort) em rio branco. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Travel Buddies Wir sind ein Team, das in den Destinationen lebt, die wir verkaufen. Unsere Buddies in Kuba, Vietnam und Namibia planen jede Reise selbst und betreuen die Gäste vor Ort. Das ist der Grund, warum Leute bei uns buchen.Wir arbeiten direkt mit lokalen Partnern, ohne Zwischenhändler. DRSF-zertifiziert, Trustpilot 4,9/5, bekannt aus WELT und Handelsblatt. Jetzt bauen wir Brasilien auf. Du wärst die erste Person dafür.Was du machst Du lebst in Brasilien und kennst das Land aus deinem Alltag, deinen Freundschaften, deiner Arbeit. Du hast zwei Aufgaben bei uns:Du sprichst mit deutschsprachigen Reisenden, die bei uns einen Beratungstermin gebucht haben. Du verstehst, was sie wollen, und planst mit uns gemeinsam ihre Reise — Routen, Unterkünfte, Erlebnisse. Du bist die Stimme aus Brasilien, wir bauen das Angebot daraus.Wenn deine Gäste in Brasilien ankommen, bist du ihr Ansprechpartner. Per Whats App, im Call, manchmal persönlich. Du löst Probleme, wenn der Inlandsflug nach Salvador gestrichen wird oder die Pousada überbucht ist. Du organisierst Begegnungen, die im Reiseführer nicht stehen — die Köchin für deine Moqueca, den Jangadeiro mit seinem Segelfloß im Nordosten, den Musiker in der Roda de Samba, den Capoeira-Lehrer, den du persönlich kennst.Du arbeitest 1:1 mit deinen Gästen. Dein Job ist, sie über dein Netzwerk und deine Geschichte mit dem Land zu verbinden.Was du mitbringen musst Du lebst seit mehreren Jahren in Brasilien. Mit Alltag, Freundeskreis, festen Strukturen. Deutsch auf Muttersprache- oder C1-Niveau. Die Beratung läuft auf Deutsch. Du hast eine eigene Geschichte mit dem Land. Warum bist du gekommen, was hält dich. Du arbeitest selbstständig und bist gut erreichbar — per Whats App und im Video-Call.Was zusätzlich hilft Portugiesisch-Kenntnisse Englisch fließend Erfahrung in Tourismus, Hospitality oder Beratung Ein eigenes Netzwerk an Hotels, Pousadas, Drivern, Köchen Vertrautheit mit CRM, Google Workspace, Whats App Business Zugang zu Menschen, die einen Gast persönlich beeindrucken: Köche, Musiker, Fischer, Capoeira-Lehrer, Flussbootskapitäne im AmazonasWas wir bieten Freelance-Vertrag mit flexiblen Stunden. Als Nebentätigkeit gedacht für jemanden, der ohnehin im Land lebt. Vergütung auf Stundenbasis plus Boni für Buchungen und gute Bewertungen. Du baust eine Destination von null auf und prägst, wie wir Brasilien machen. Ein eingespieltes Team im Rücken: Buchungen, Verträge, Tools, Versicherung. Du machst das, was nur du kannst. Langfristige Zusammenarbeit über Jahre.
